description: ERC-20 token balance of a wallet on Linea (USDC, USDT or WETH by ticker, any token by address, via balanceOf): raw amount, decimals, symbol and the human-readable amount, live from the token contract. Use to check stablecoin or token holdings before a transfer or trade; for the native coin use linea_balance. The token is a ticker such as USDC, USDT or WETH or its 0x address; no contract or a non-ERC-20 contract returns 422, uncharged. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

token.description: Token: a ticker such as USDC, USDT, WETH or DAI, or the 0x ERC-20 contract address
